title: precheck names a planned check whose kb path filter selects no fact unit or file, which can never pass
goal: SP-tjap3mdd retrospective: BG-shomh4nz's planned check filtered kbfacts units by path.endswith('/single-package-extras.md'), which the article public/arch/python-single-package-extras.md never matches, so it could not pass; precheck showed it failing at planning, read as the premise, and the worker had to correct it under a provisional gate. precheck in _tools/bl_land.py warns of a check whose endswith or == literal on a kb article path matches no file under kb/, naming the literal.

run:
import sys,tempfile,subprocess,io,contextlib,argparse,os
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import bl_base,bl_land
def one(**v):
    return {'BG-bbbbbbbb': v}
def run(sg,items,files=()):
    d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
    subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d],check=True)
    for p,t in files:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.join(d,p)),exist_ok=True)
        open(os.path.join(d,p),'w').write(t)
    subprocess.run(['git','-C',d,'add','-A'],check=True)
    bl=bl_base.Backlog(d)
    bl.items['SP-aaaaaaaa']=dict(id='SP-aaaaaaaa',kind='sprint',title='s',status='planned',goal=sg)
    for k,v in items.items():
        it=dict(id=k,sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa',status='draft',title='t',checks=[dict(run=['python3','-c','import sys; sys.exit(1)'])])
        it.update(v)
        bl.items[k]=it
    o=io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(o):
        bl_land.cmd_precheck(bl,argparse.Namespace(sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa'))
    return [l for l in o.getvalue().splitlines() if l.startswith('warning')]
files=[('kb/public/arch/python-single-package-extras.md','x')]
def chk(lit):
    return [dict(run=['python3','-c','import sys; print([1 for p in [1] if str(p).endswith("'+lit+'")]); sys.exit(1)'])]
bad=run('g',one(kind='story',goal='Pins a fact.',touches=['x.py'],checks=chk('/single-package-extras.md')),files)
good=run('g',one(kind='story',goal='Pins a fact.',touches=['x.py'],checks=chk('/python-single-package-extras.md')),files)
sys.exit(0 if any('/single-package-extras.md' in l for l in bad) and not any('python-single-package-extras.md' in l for l in good) else 1)
